'''Treffelt Wuin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a mid-level [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]] assigned to the [[Bissillirus Resupply Base]]. Passed over for promotion, Wuin started to supply information on the base to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] through the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Hennilrum]]. Wuin came into possession of vital information regarding the base and a supply convoy, and demanded an extraction from the base and relocation to an Alliance [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]] in return for the information. An Alliance team infiltrated the under-construction station posing as the security detachment of [[Ensil Moiss]] and effected his extraction.
